verses.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the kehillah of the Thessalonians in ELOHIM the Father and Adonai Yeshua Mashiach: Grace to you and peace.
We give thanks to ELOHIM always for all of you, constantly mentioning you in our prayers,
remembering before our ELOHIM and Father your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Adonai Yeshua Mashiach.
For we know, brothers loved by ELOHIM, that he has chosen you,
because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power and in the Ruach Kodesh and with full conviction. You know what kind of men we proved to be among you for your sake.
And you became imitators of us and of Adonai, for you received the word in much affliction, with the joy of the Ruach Kodesh,
so that you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and in Achaia.
For not only has the word of Adonai sounded forth from you in Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in ELOHIM has gone forth everywhere, so that we need not say anything.
For they themselves report concerning us the kind of reception we had among you, and how you turned to ELOHIM from idols to serve the living and true ELOHIM,
and to wait for his Son from the skies, whom he raised from the dead, Yeshua who delivers us from the wrath to come.
